extracted.stage: Estate administration; property yet to be sold
extracted.summary: A partner at Achebe & Lockwood Legal, instructed by the executors of an illiquid Reading estate valued at around £600,000, enquires about borrowing £113,000 to cover inheritance tax and professional fees pending sale of the property.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the estate administration. We have noted the approximate estate value of £600,000 and the £113,000 sought for tax and professional fees pending the sale of the property. To take this further we would need confirmation of the grant of probate position, details of the estate's assets and liabilities, the identity of the executors, any IHT payment deadline, and confirmation of the firm acting. Once we have received those details, a member of our team will review the enquiry and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of finance or legal advice.
